strategyReview: Working: WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG is the proven live workhorse (346/500 live wins, +0.31% avg, blocked shadows 188/253 at +0.99%), and gated/manual NO-fade variants are strong when framed as contract premium decays. Failing: broad one-touch/no-bias shadow fades, PM proxy shorts, funding-extreme live trades, and most cross-asset/listed-IV momentum confirmations are negative or coin-flip. The most actionable edge is the outcome-panel NO cut localized to mid-price, near-dated, low-edge contracts.

failureClusters.theme: PM directional proxy shorts invert or lag the source signal
failureClusters.evidence: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG_PM_PROXY_SHORT is 3/22 shadows with avg -2.85%; PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW_PM_PROXY_SHORT is 1/16 avg -6.12%; OPT_IV_GT_PM_IV_DOWNSIDE is 2/16 avg -9.95%. One recent GOLD proxy short lost -2.3% while the source closed +0.91% and was marked 'opposite_direction'.
failureClusters.recommendation: Stop translating spot/funding/positioning signals into Polymarket directional proxy shorts. Keep Polymarket exposure only for contract-native YES/NO premium edges.

failureClusters.theme: Un-gated YES/NO edge fades are too broad
failureClusters.evidence: Broad ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO shadows are only 108/280 with avg -0.82%; NO_BIAS_ADJUSTED_GAP_SHADOW is 39/99 avg -1.41%; RELATIVE_VALUE_HEATMAP is 4/15 avg -8.09%. The gated one-touch NO variant (above-strike, edge 3-8, tighter conditions) is 80/132 avg +1.58%.
failureClusters.recommendation: Kill broad underlying-cap/no-bias spot-decline variants. Author only contract-native NO fades with explicit gates: above direction, moderate edge, mid price, near expiry, and contract PnL prediction.

failureClusters.theme: HYPE-based BTC confirmation is late risk-on echo
failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion is 9/25 scorable (36%) and btc_listed_iv_momentum_confirmation is 4/17 (24%). BTC long entries frequently occur near 7d highs, and HYPE-above-SMA/stable-OI does not separate durable move from late FOMO.
failureClusters.recommendation: Do not treat HYPE participation as independent BTC confirmation. Prefer BTC-native signals or contract/panel edges; otherwise retire the family.

failureClusters.theme: Per-asset weekend funding reversion variants fire on non-events and score the wrong variable
failureClusters.evidence: MU 5/16, CBRS 13/27, and AAPL 10/19 scorable wins. Tests often show funding_normalize_up outcomes rather than the stated spot >2% prediction, and entries appear near neutral or stale 5.5% funding rather than true negative extremes.
failureClusters.recommendation: Require true weekend and bottom-decile funding extreme if pursuing these variants; otherwise defer to the parent WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG signal instead of isolated per-asset thresholds.

hypothesisReviews.observation: CBRS family is 13/27 scorable (48%), and the example tests are scored as funding_normalize_up rather than the stated CBRS spot >2% move. Entries appear near neutral or stale funding levels, so the < -10 condition is not isolating a real crowded-short extreme.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A standalone CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and forces a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Cross-asset IV compression/vol expansion is 9/25 scorable (36%). HYPE above SMA with stable OI enters BTC near 7d highs, and the wins are explosive but too rare; HYPE risk-on is not independent confirmation of durable BTC upside.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above SMA with stable OI confirms durable BTC upside rather than late-stage FOMO/overextension.

hypothesisReviews.observation: AAPL variant is 10/19 scorable (53%) but outcomes score funding normalization instead of AAPL spot >2%. The < -10 threshold admits non-extreme weekday prints and does not identify genuine short-positioning stress.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: AAPL funding below -10% on any day rapidly normalizes and yields a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: BTC listed-IV momentum confirmation is 4/17 scorable (24%). The tests are direction-confused and the premise of spot momentum plus rising options IV producing further >2% BTC gains is not holding; the family should be killed or re-written as a contract/IV event, not a spot continuation.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Spot momentum confirmed by rising options IV reliably leads to further >2% BTC gains within 3-7 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: MU variant is 5/16 scorable (31%) and frequently shows 5.5% or positive funding readings, suggesting entries fire on stale/default data rather than a true < -10% extreme. The intended mechanism is not actually being tested, so more threshold variants are unlikely to help.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Extreme negative MU funding (< -10%) outside true weekend hours reliably normalizes and produces >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Gold one-touch cap-edge variant is 2/14 scorable (14%) with 5 unscorable. The primary prediction was a >2% GOLD spot decline, but examples are scored on contract PnL and the NO contract often barely moves. The underlying-cap edge did not translate into either spot follow-through or consistent contract PnL.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large underlying-cap edge on gold upside one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: HYPE relative OI breakout continuation remains viable in its own family: 12 active tests at 75% win and the setup-family has 19/45 live trades with positive average PnL. Keep it as a HYPE-specific continuation signal, not as a cross-asset BTC confirmation.

OIL one-touch NO heatmap cluster is the correct contract-native framing: 35 tests at 100% win in active hypotheses. Continue treating it as a gated OIL NO premium fade rather than a spot-decline call.

journalEntry: Tonight focused on localizing the proven YES-overpricing edge instead of chasing broad shadow themes. I authored sibling NO variants from FIND-0065/0066/0067/0068/0069/0070 and an informed-flow variant, and re-authored H-534 as a contract premium fade rather than a gold spot-decline call. I also refined H-539 to require weekend and bottom-decile funding. The struggling families are diagnosed and their invalid assumptions recorded: HYPE confirmation of BTC, listed-IV BTC momentum, weak per-asset funding thresholds, and the gold underlying-cap spot-decline premise are all invalidated. No parameter changes were made because live risk/reward evidence was mixed and did not clearly support shifting stops or targets. Immediate kill candidates are broad PM proxy shorts, no-bias gap spot predictions, and stale MU/AAPL/CBRS per-asset threshold variants.
